scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.check:emdash: grep -rnI --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=evidence "$(printf '\342\200\224')" apps/web/src apps/web/public apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/app.json apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/hooks apps/mobile/lib apps/mobile/locales apps/mobile/modules apps/mobile/plugins apps/mobile/targets apps/mobile/theme.ts packages docs README.md; s=$?; if [ $s -eq 0 ]; then echo 'verify: em dash (U+2014) found in the files above' >&2; fi; [ $s -eq 1 ]
scripts.verify: npm run test:all && npm run check:emdash
